title: Reject research candidates that fail verified success
narrative: A cheap backend fails verified success against a frozen baseline. Research must reject it, keep negative results, and only promote noninferior survivors. Candidates cannot rewrite the evaluator. Related: `taloneth_validator_qualification`. Generic research loop for self-revising MH-SR-06; recipe-from-traces: `taloneth_insp_recipe_evolution_loop`[^insp-sr-06-research].
implementation:
`ResearchLab` / `EvalProtocol` run bounded research: inspect → hypothesis → isolated experiment → ATK-style search → frozen evaluation protocol → promote/rollback. Production evaluators stay protected.

Covers: EXP-01, EXP-02, EXP-03, EXP-04.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `atk_research_reject.yaml`. Hard expects on declared observation keys.
